//: Declarations for the published tarball, emitted unconditionally. The main tsconfig is `composite` and incremental, which is right for the workspace build and wrong here: `tsup` wipes `dist/` first, and an incremental compiler reading a build-info file that describes files it can no longer see decides there is nothing to do — so the tarball shipped JavaScript with no types at all, and a consumer got `implicitly has an 'any' type` from inside node_modules. This one is neither composite nor incremental, so every pack emits.
